name: Kids Daily Spark
tagline: A one-page STEM hook for each kid, every day, with a 30-second try-it
description: Each day it prepares a single page per child built around one real science or technology idea, a hook that makes it stick, and a hands-on mini experiment that takes about half a minute. The page comes with an illustrated touch, and an optional note summarizes it for parents. Scales across kids of different ages.
author: HelloBenL
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
